  "evidence_ids": ["E1.1"],
  "reasons": [
    "Total profit for 3 years = Rs 30,000 + Rs 36,000 + Rs 42,000 = Rs 1,08,000.",
    "Average profit = Rs 1,08,000 / 3 = Rs 36,000.",
    "Goodwill = Average profit * Number of years' purchase = Rs 36,000 * 4 = Rs 1,44,000."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Goodwill Valuation",
  "syllabus_topic": "Methods of valuation: Average profit method",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Profits of the last three years are Rs 30,000, Rs 36,000, and Rs 42,000.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Goodwill is valued at 4 years' purchase of average profits.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Goodwill equals average profit multiplied by the number of years' purchase.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "The question asks for the average annual profit rather than the capitalised goodwill value.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Goodwill equals the simple sum of the past three years' profits without multiplying by 4.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Goodwill is 4 years' purchase of the total three-year profits instead of average profits.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Directly tests Goodwill valuation using the average profit method from Unit II."

      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Standard concise numerical MCQ format characteristic of CUET UG Accountancy."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Direct two-step numerical problem well within standard Class 12 exam difficulty."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Distractors isolate common errors: average profit alone, total profit, or multiplying total profit."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 2,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "application",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": []
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "The profits of a firm for the last three years were Rs 30,000, Rs 36,000 and Rs 42,000. Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Average profit is Rs 36,000; multiplying by 4 gives Rs 1,44,000."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 36,000",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Rs 36,000 is only the average profit, not 4 years' purchase of it."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 1,08,000",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Rs 1,08,000 is the three-year total profit, not 4 years' purchase of average profit."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 4,32,000",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Rs 4,32,000 wrongly multiplies total profits (1,08,000 * 4) rather than average profits."
    }
  ]
}
